name: version-control-with-github
description: This Colors web application allows users to log in with a valid username and password. They will be notified if their login is invalid. Once logged in, they can add colors. A confirmation message will show, and the color will be stored to the user's account. They can also search for colors, which will be displayed. The user is also able to log out.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:html && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
